review.summary: DAG ownership, dependency order, producer-before-registration sequencing, and the existing execution-time verification bindings are otherwise executable. However, AC-07’s required auditable, per-workflow evidence and records do not have a concrete producing task or verification obligation, so the frozen R11 acceptance contract is not fully carried by the plan.

issues.title: AC-07 audit evidence and required records have no concrete producer or verification
issues.detail: Spec R11 requires current-workflow evidence identifying source baseline, workflow ID, Spec/Ticket/DAG versions, dependency installation/tree-copy/digest costs, plus auditable test evidence, issue/fix records, the actual DSH_PLAN_V2 DAG, Owner Registry record, and external-block conclusion. Ticket R11 repeats this as an acceptance requirement. No task is owned by product-docs; every quality task is limited to tests/**, while integrate_critical_journeys has write: [] and only asserts unspecified “sanitized workflow evidence” in done. None of the 16 existing verification bindings checks that a durable sanitized record contains the mandated fields and conclusions. Therefore the plan cannot establish either the output location/owner or an executable acceptance producer for this non-test artifact requirement.
issues.suggestion: Revise the final integration path to include a product-docs-owned leaf task after integration (or an explicitly scoped equivalent) that writes a defined sanitized R11 evidence/record artifact under docs/**. Its done must enumerate the required provenance, dependency-cost accounting, actual verification-result references, defect/fix and external-block conclusions, DSH_PLAN_V2/Owner Registry references, and must explicitly prohibit sensitive values. Bind a concrete verification that validates the artifact’s required fields and redaction. Make it depend on integrate_critical_journeys so it records actual execution results; if final acceptance is meant to include this artifact check, add that dependency and binding explicitly.

technicalFacts: The plan has no product-docs task despite the registry defining product-docs with docs/** scope.
integrate_critical_journeys has write: [] and its existing bindings only execute suites, typechecks, and builds.
No existing verification command validates a durable evidence record or its required R11 provenance, cost, and conclusion fields.
